eval-001.rationale: Explicit ask with same-day deadline and material business consequence (slipped billing).

eval-002.rationale: Production outage with 100% error rate; clear bug signal and active impact.

eval-003.rationale: Routine how-to question from a user; no urgency, no incident.

eval-004.rationale: Informational broadcast; explicit 'no action needed' with an opt-out option.

eval-005.rationale: Unsolicited marketing pitch with discount and unsubscribe footer; classic vendor blast.

eval-006.rationale: Conversational ack with no clear ask, bug, or info; doesn't fit a substantive bucket.

eval-007.rationale: Customer reporting reproducible defect with timing and rate; not an outage but a real bug.

eval-008.rationale: Explicit deliverable with a one-week deadline; routine planning ask, not an emergency.

eval-009.rationale: Bulk event promotion with sponsor list; not personalized, no action expected from us.

eval-010.rationale: Vague, anonymous, no actionable content; ambiguous by design and should be flagged for human review.
